_name: probe-2026-09-22-post-rebuild-2 - the SRP arc, as a scored run
_why:
The demo question set, turned into a probe so the answers are checked rather than read. Run after probe-2026-09-22-post-rebuild.json:
  manage.py nessie --tier full --cases /app/NessieAI/tests/nessie_tests/probes/probe-2026-09-22-post-rebuild-2.json --out /app/runs/srp-arc-20260922
Twelve NExtSEEK turns, no Container-CC turn, so it is the cheap one of the two.
_truths: Every number was re-measured in the live local graph on 2026-09-22 by the session that wrote this file, not taken from the set it came from: MIT_SRP holds 57,426 samples through IN_PROJECT (15 more reach an SRP-titled Investigation without being in the project, which is why a text-ish OR answers 57,441); ENG owns 50,639 samples by the UID rule; 13,433 MIT_SRP tissues have a folded Organ of liver, against 6,721 spelled exactly Liver; the folded Organ list is liver 13,433, lung 8,998, kidney 4,911, pancreas 3,320, spleen 2,676, blood 1,438; 2,111 MIT_SRP mice mention NDMA; 982 ENG tissues have a D.SEQ descendant within 12 hops; PMID 36233095 has 3,022 samples; 10 published studies sit under MIT_SRP, carrying 6,496 samples; the Swager lab is D.IMG 1,195, CHM 198, D.SPC 139, D.NMR 54, A.SPC 32, A.NMR 21; and CometChip touches 2,270 distinct samples across 304,062 edges.
_not_on_stage: Two deliberate omissions. A chained follow-up ('find me mice treated with NDMA' then 'of those, what downstream types exist?') is the defect fixed today and is scored in the other probe, not here, so this file asks its downstream questions standalone. And Collaborative Cross is a different population from SRP, so it stays in the other file too.

srp_demo.description: Scope, harmonization, the NDMA chain, then breadth.

variants.name: Act 1: the project relationship, not a title match
variants._why: 57,426 is the project; 57,441 is what an OR against investigation titles returns. The 15-sample gap is the whole difference between a scope and a text search.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many samples are in the MIT_SRP project?

variants.name: Act 1: a lab lives at the lab position of the UID
variants._why: 50,639. Needs SEEK's institution list to map the name to ENG, and that file is written at runtime and never baked, so a miss here can be the labs document rather than the rule. srp2.eng_code_in_uid is the control for exactly that.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many samples does the Engelward lab have?

variants.name: Act 1 control: the same answer without the institution list
variants._why: Same number by the same rule, with the code handed over so nothing has to resolve a name. If this passes and the one above fails, the labs document is the problem.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many samples have ENG at the lab position of their UID?

variants.name: Act 2: harmonization, the thing only the graph does
variants._why: 13,433 once the case is folded. Liver, LIVER and liver are three stored spellings, and 6,721 is the answer that takes only the capitalised one.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many tissue samples in the MIT_SRP project came from the liver?

variants.name: Act 2: the harmonization pitch in one answer
variants._why: The folded distribution, not a single value. liver 13,433 and lung 8,998 are the two the reply must carry for this to be the list rather than a sample of it.

turns.label: main
turns.query: Which spellings of the Organ field are in use across the SRP tissues?

variants.name: Act 2: what curation is up against, scored on candour not on a number
variants._why: The same genotype is written as 'aag -/-', spelled out in full, and abbreviated 'rgam'. There is no single right number, so the only thing worth asserting is that the reply says the spelling varies instead of picking one and sounding certain.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many Aag-knockout mice are there?

variants.name: Act 3: the contaminant that runs through all three labs

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many mice in the MIT_SRP project were treated with NDMA?

variants.name: Act 3: a real lineage traversal, which no keyword search can answer
variants._why: 982. A sequencing record does not carry its ancestor's organ or genotype, so this has to walk DERIVED_FROM.

turns.label: main
turns.query: Which tissue samples from the Engelward lab have sequencing data downstream?

variants.name: Act 3: identifier lookup, which this round fixed
variants._why: 3,022 samples under PMID 36233095, the NDMA CometChip paper. The old failure was a substituted search on the word PMID.

turns.label: main
turns.query: Find the samples associated with PMID 36233095

variants.name: Act 3: provenance
variants._why: 10 published studies under MIT_SRP. A study counts as published when it carries a DOI or a PMID, and the unset value is an empty string, not null.

turns.label: main
turns.query: Which SRP papers have samples in NExtSEEK?

variants.name: Act 4: same project, a completely different data shape
variants._why: CHM 198, D.SPC 139, D.NMR 54 and the rest. The point is breadth, so the reply has to name the chemistry types rather than a single total.

turns.label: main
turns.query: What chemical characterization data does the Swager lab have?

variants.name: Act 4 stress test: rows are not samples
variants._why: 2,270 distinct samples across 304,062 CometChip edges. A query that counts rows is wrong by a factor of 134, and that is the rule the graph prompt spends a bullet on.

turns.label: main
turns.query: How many samples underwent the CometChip assay?
